{{Quote|We have created a bomb for you to use. Fly down and fire up your tow-cable!|Ralltiir scientist to Red Squadron|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
'''Tow-cable bombs''' were explosives developed on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-sympathizing [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As the name suggested, they were [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] created specifically to be carried by any vehicles carrying [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cables]]. The bomb's explosive charge and yield was powerful enough to total an entire bridge upon impact.

During the [[Defense of Ralltiir]], the various Ralltiir scientists developed a bomb in anticipation of [[Red Squadron]] and the Rebel Alliance to arrive at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to aid them in the oncoming blockade and onslaught from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, and gave them the okay to fire the tow cables to deliver them to blow up the various bridges into the [[City/Legends|city]] to prevent the Imperial ground forces' arrival into the city.
